All objectives verified. Final state confirmed: RD-1015 archived, status Ready, 0 parts.

**Report**

1. **DONE** — Ticket `s3ab RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**, customer Marlow Bakery, created 2026-08-22). Verified present in the tickets list.
2. **DONE** — Part `s3ab RD Part A` (cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1) computed price **$125.00**.
3. **DONE** — Part `s3ab RD Part B` (cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1) computed price **$250.00**. (Ticket total at that point: $375.00.)
4. **DONE** — After editing Part A's cost from 100 → 150, its computed price was **$187.50** (ticket total $437.50).
5. **DONE** — Status reached **Ready**. The precondition discovered: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. Clicking "Mark Ready" with unsupplied parts produced an alert reading `Ticket is not ready` with the items `Part "s3ab RD Part A" has no supplier` and `Part "s3ab RD Part B" has no supplier`. I set supplier "Acme Parts" on both parts via Edit, after which "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status badge changed from `Draft` to `Ready` (buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed").
6. **DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via a Confirm dialog: `Delete the part "s3ab RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone.` / same for Part B, confirmed with "Delete part"). The parts table then read `No parts on this ticket yet.` The ticket was then archived — the detail page showed `Status: Ready` plus an `Archived` badge and the button changed to "Unarchive ticket". The default tickets list no longer shows RD-1015; with "Show archived" checked it appears as `RD-1015 | s3ab RD Bench Ticket Archived | Marlow Bakery | Ready | 0 | 2026-08-22`. Nothing from this run remains active.
